name: Stony Brook University robotic assay platform: Formulatrix Mantis + BMG PHERAstar (NIH S10; 2020)
brief: A university screening facility wants a small-volume robotic assay platform: a microfluidic reagent dispenser for 6- to 1536-well plates, paired with a multi-mode microplate reader, run from one controller computer.

cost.excludes_note: NIH S10 award for the dispenser and reader as one integrated platform; integration is stated to be routine. Staffing and service contracts are not in the award.

notes: Out-of-sample round 2: collected blind after the model was frozen at commit 973d0f5. includes corrected from ['instruments'] to ['analytics', 'instruments'] after scoring, by the rule that a purchase of named equipment covers those items' cost categories (the round-2 collection prompt omitted the category convention). Out-of-sample (oos2 set), found after the cost model was frozen; not used for catalog prices. price_basis=configured (two instruments as an integrated platform). Quote: "The robotic assay platform consists of a liquid handling robot ... Key features of the Mantis (Formulatrix) liquid handling robot ... Key features of the multi-mode plate reader (PHERAstar)". Verified 3 Oct 2026 via RePORTER API, award_amount 173354. Mantis exact; PHERAstar named without FSX suffix so proxy to pherastar_fsx.

equipment.rationale: Closest catalog model to the item named in the source.
